cues.text: Sit-to-stand. It helps with getting up from any chair.
cues.caption: Sit-to-stand

cues.text: Scoot to the front of your chair. Feet flat, about hip-width apart.
cues.caption:
Scoot forward
Feet flat

cues.text: If you need help, put your hands on the chair and push. That's a great way to start.
cues.caption:
Need help?
Push the chair

cues.text: Lean forward, nose over toes… and stand up.
cues.caption:
Lean forward
Stand up

cues.text: Now sit back down, slowly. Reach back for the chair with your hips.
cues.caption:
Sit down
slowly

cues.text: Take a breath whenever you need one.
cues.caption: Breathe
